_note: Hardware-risk items of BRIEFING A1 "Simulator blind spots" as data (PLAYBOOK 6b reviews them item by item). The text stays in BRIEFING: `source` is file#phrase and tools/knowledge.py check fails when the phrase is gone. `when`: predicates (docs/techniques/predicates.json) that must hold for the item to matter; empty = every build. An item applies unless a `when` predicate is known false. `cover`: the toolkit check or hardware-checklist line the source names. `python tools/knowledge.py risks GAME` lists the items for a game.
